title: 第7章 我为天帝，当镇杀世间一切敌！
content_zh:
“想要追随我？”君逍遥略微讶然。
君玲珑的这种想法，他真没有猜到。
成为追随者这种事情，非常普遍。
君家十大序列，每一位序列身后，都有一批实力不凡的追随者。
或是君家内部的天骄弟子，或是从外面招揽驯服的人才。
总而言之，每一位盖世人物，都会培养追随者，日后会成为一股重要力量。
甚至是他的父亲君无悔，都曾有过一批追随者，被世人称为神王八部众，每一位都可独当一面，堪称盖世英杰。
君逍遥倒也不是没考虑过，只是他现在才三岁，根本不急着招揽追随者，因此没有在意过。
“为什么？”君逍遥好奇。
就因为他打破了万古极境吗？
“一种直觉。”君玲珑美眸深邃道。
那一角未来，她不方便说，因为说出去，很有可能要承受某种巨大的因果。
君玲珑还无法承受那种后果。
“直觉？”君逍遥无言以对。
他也察觉到了，君玲珑恐怕知道了一些什么，却没有明说出来。
不过他倒是也偶尔听过君玲珑的事情。
天生七窍玲珑心，心思机敏聪颖，参悟任何功法武学都快人一步。
若是不陨落，日后注定可以成圣。
这种天之骄女，放在哪里都是众星捧月的存在，倒也有资格追随君逍遥。
“现在每天是爷爷照顾我起居，除了给我讲道，就是唠叨让我长大给君家开枝散叶……”君逍遥心里无奈。

他虽然外表只有三岁，但内心可早就成熟了，成天面对一个糟老头子，即便是自己的爷爷，也会很枯燥的。
“让君玲珑当个丫鬟伺候起居也不错。”君逍遥想道。
他倒是没有想过去培养君玲珑什么的，不过若是当个丫鬟侍女，倒也可以接受。
若是让外人知道君逍遥的想法，一定连锤死他的心都有了。
竟然想让众星捧月，万人瞩目的天之骄女当丫鬟？
要知道，哪怕如君仗剑那等天骄序列，也只是想要拉拢君玲珑成为同修而已。
就在君逍遥要开口时，一道女声却是传来。
“君玲珑，你竟然主动要追随别人？”
开口质问之人，正是兰清雅。
她不敢冒犯君逍遥，只能将话锋对准君玲珑。
“怎么了？”君玲珑淡然道。
面对君逍遥，她会忐忑，紧张，但对兰清雅可是没什么拘谨。
“仗剑公子曾亲自开口，想要招揽你，却被你拒绝，而今你却主动追随他人，这让仗剑公子的脸往哪里放？”兰清雅脸色难看道。
君玲珑此举，不是赤裸裸地打君仗剑的脸吗？
“君仗剑很优秀，但我君玲珑追随之人，将是镇压一个时代的存在！”君玲珑语气带着一缕狂热。
“呵……镇压一个时代？你的意思难道是指他？”兰清雅下意识说道，口无遮拦。
“哼，哪来的不知礼数的东西！”
君逍遥还没说什么，君战天眉毛便是一掀，衣袖一甩！
兰清雅娇躯被击飞，狠狠坠落在地上，嘴角流血。
这还是君战天自恃身份，懒得将兰清雅灭杀。

“以后若有机会，倒是想和仗剑族兄切磋一番，至于你，滚吧……”君逍遥平淡道。
他都懒得对这种小角色出手。
兰清雅脸色煞白，看了看君玲珑，眼底露出一缕不甘之色，转身即走。
君玲珑没有在意，而是眸光定定地凝视着君逍遥，美目中竟是流露一缕楚楚可怜之色。
换做其他任何男性，怕是早就迫不及待答应了。
君逍遥沉吟一会儿后问道：“会伺候人吗？”
此话一出，众人都是楞了。
堂堂君家女天骄，何曾伺候过人？
君玲珑也是愣了愣，不过还是下意识的点了点头。
这个机会，她可要把握住。
“好，那我同意了。”君逍遥很是干脆道。
这下，君玲珑和周围的人都是反应了过来。
敢情君逍遥不是在挑选追随者，而是在挑选侍女啊。
一时间，在场所有男性天骄，都是露出羡慕嫉妒的眼光。
让君玲珑当侍女丫鬟，可不是谁都能够办到的。
君玲珑自己也是恍惚了一瞬，她堂堂天之骄女，还真成丫鬟了？
不过一想到那一角未来，君玲珑美眸便是露出坚定之色。
她轻启玉唇问道：“神子大人问了这么多，那么玲珑可否也问一个问题？”
“什么问题？”君逍遥道。
“若神子大人日后成为天帝，该当如何？”君玲珑问完，眸光定定，凝视君逍遥。

君逍遥微楞，而后淡笑着摇头道：“很简单……”
“我为天帝，当镇杀世间一切敌！”
君逍遥一语话落。
顿时，天外雷霆炸响，苍穹风云震荡！
言出法随，令天地色变！
所有人露出骇然之色，这种场面，他们见所未见。
君战天也是深吸了一口气，目光无比复杂。
“无悔，你的孩儿，果然如同当年的你一般，豪情万丈……”
君战天知道，这一句话，代表了一个大因果，落在了君逍遥身上。
就在君逍遥说出此话的同时。
仙域一处生命禁区，一道无比古老沙哑的声音传出。
“君家这一代，野心不小啊，呵呵……”
另外，一处神凰飞舞，真凤盘旋的古老灵山，传来冷然讽笑之声。
“镇杀世间一切敌，呵……君无悔的后人狂妄到这种地步了吗？”
一处龙脉汇聚的古巢之中，也是传来冷漠话语。
“这一世帝路将现，我族龙傲天等后人，将会让君家等荒古世家明白，何谓天骄喋血，满目凄凉！”
君逍遥恐怕也没想到，自己随口说出的一句话，竟然会引起这种震动。
待他回过神来时，却发现君玲珑的目光无比明亮，紧盯着他。
“怎么了？”君逍遥摸了摸自己的脸。
“玲珑愿意追随神子大人左右！”君玲珑彻底下定决心，再无动摇。

从那一句话，君玲珑就明白了很多。
君逍遥点头，这一次的收获倒是圆满。
签到获得了神象镇狱劲，打破万古极境，获得了天道奖励，混沌神魔观想法。
更是得到了十八祖赏赐的三株不死神药。
最后竟然还招到了一个金发妹子当丫鬟，可以说是功德圆满。
content_en:
"Want to follow me?" Jun Xiaoyao was slightly surprised.
He really didn't expect Jun Linglong's thoughts.
Becoming a follower is very common.
Behind each of the top ten sequences of the Jun family, there is a group of followers with extraordinary strength.
Either they are talented disciples within the Jun family, or they recruit tame talents from outside.
All in all, every great figure will cultivate followers who will become an important force in the future.
Even his father, Jun Wuhui, once had a group of followers who were called the Eight Tribes of the God King by the world. Each one of them was capable of their own role and could be called an unparalleled hero.
It's not that Jun Xiaoyao hasn't considered it, but he is only three years old now and is not in a hurry to recruit followers, so he hasn't cared about it.
"Why?" Jun Xiaoyao was curious.
Is it because he broke the eternal realm?
"An intuition." Jun Linglong said with deep eyes.
It was not convenient for her to talk about that part of the future, because if she told her, she would most likely have to suffer some huge consequences.
Jun Linglong couldn't bear the consequences yet.
"Intuition?" Jun Xiaoyao was speechless.
He also noticed that Jun Linglong might have known something, but she didn't say it clearly.
However, he had occasionally heard about Jun Linglong.
He is born with an exquisite heart with seven orifices, and his mind is astute and intelligent. He is one step ahead of others in comprehending any martial arts.
If he does not perish, he is destined to become a saint in the future.
Such a proud daughter of heaven, who is always admired by the stars wherever she is, is qualified to follow Jun Xiaoyao.
"Now grandpa takes care of my daily life every day. In addition to preaching to me, he also nags me to grow up and help the Jun family..." Jun Xiaoyao felt helpless.
Although he is only three years old on the outside, he has already matured on the inside. Facing a bad old man all day long, even his own grandfather, would be boring.
"It wouldn't be a bad idea to let Jun Linglong serve as a maid." Jun Xiaoyao thought.
He didn't think about training Jun Linglong or anything, but if he was a maid, he could accept it.
If outsiders knew Jun Xiaoyao's thoughts, they would definitely be willing to kill him.
You actually want the proud girl of heaven, who is admired by all the stars and admired by thousands of people, to be your maid?
You must know that even the geniuses such as Jun Zhanjian only want to win over Jun Linglong to become a fellow practitioner.
Just when Jun Xiaoyao was about to speak, a female voice came.
"Jun Linglong, you actually want to follow someone else?"
The person who asked the question was Lan Qingya.
She didn't dare to offend Jun Xiaoyao, so she could only target Jun Linglong.
"What's wrong?" Jun Linglong said calmly.
When facing Jun Xiaoyao, she would feel uneasy and nervous, but she was not cautious about Lan Qingya.
"Young Master Zhanjian once personally spoke to recruit you, but you refused, and now you are actively following others. Where does this make Young Master Zhanjian look?" Lan Qingya said with an ugly face.
Isn't Jun Linglong's move a naked slap in Jun Zhanjian's face?
"Jun Zhanjian is very good, but those who follow me, Jun Linglong, will suppress the existence of an era!" Jun Linglong said with a hint of fanaticism.
"Huh... Suppressing an era? Do you mean him?" Lan Qingya said subconsciously, speaking without restraint.
"Humph, where does this disrespectful thing come from!"
Before Jun Xiaoyao said anything, Jun Zhantian raised his eyebrows and flicked his sleeves!
Lan Qingya's delicate body was knocked away and she fell hard to the ground, bleeding from the corner of her mouth.
This is because Jun Zhantian relied on his identity and was too lazy to kill Lan Qingya.
"If there is a chance in the future, I would like to compete with brother Zhanjian Clan. As for you, go away..." Jun Xiaoyao said calmly.
He didn't even bother to take action against such a small character.
Lan Qingya's face turned pale, she looked at Jun Linglong, with a hint of unwillingness in her eyes, and turned around to leave.
Jun Linglong didn't pay attention, but stared at Jun Xiaoyao steadily, with a hint of pity in her beautiful eyes.
If it were any other man, I’m afraid he would haveI couldn’t wait to agree.
Jun Xiaoyao pondered for a while and then asked: "Can you serve others?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned.
How has the proud daughter of the Jun family ever served anyone before?
Jun Linglong was also stunned, but nodded subconsciously.
She must seize this opportunity.
"Okay, then I agree." Jun Xiaoyao said simply.
At this time, Jun Linglong and the people around her reacted.
Daqingjun Xiaoyao is not choosing followers, but choosing maids.
For a moment, all the male geniuses present looked with envy and jealousy.
Not everyone can make Jun Linglong a maid.
Jun Linglong herself was in a daze for a moment. She, the proud daughter of heaven, has really become a maid?
But when she thought about that future, Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes showed determination.
She lightly opened her jade lips and asked, "Sir Shenzi has asked so many questions, can Linglong also ask a question?"
"What's the problem?" Jun Xiaoyao asked.
"What will happen if the Son of God becomes the Emperor of Heaven in the future?" After Jun Linglong asked, her eyes fixed on Jun Xiaoyao.
Jun Xiaoyao was stunned, then smiled and shook his head: "It's very simple..."
"As the Emperor of Heaven, I shall kill all enemies in the world!"
Jun Xiaoyao finished speaking.
Suddenly, thunder exploded in the sky, and the sky shook!
The words are followed and the color of heaven and earth changes!
Everyone looked horrified. They had never seen such a scene before.
Jun Zhantian also took a deep breath, his eyes extremely complicated.
"Wugui, your child is indeed just like you back then, full of pride..."
Jun Zhantian knew that this sentence represented a big cause and effect that fell on Jun Xiaoyao.
At the same time Jun Xiaoyao said this.
In a restricted area of ​​life in the Immortal Realm, an extremely ancient and hoarse voice came out.
"This generation of the Jun family is very ambitious, haha..."
In addition, from an ancient spiritual mountain where divine phoenixes were flying and real phoenixes were hovering, a cold and sarcastic sound came from the place.
"Suppress all enemies in the world, haha...are Jun Wuhui's descendants so arrogant?"
In an ancient nest where dragon veins gathered, indifferent words were also heard.
"In this life, the emperor's path will be revealed. The descendants of our clan, Long Aotian, will make the Jun family and other ancient families understand what it means to be a proud man who sheds blood and is desolate!"
Jun Xiaoyao probably didn't expect that his casual words would cause such a shock.
When he came back to his senses, he found that Jun Linglong's eyes were extremely bright, staring at him.
"What's wrong?" Jun Xiaoyao touched his face.
"Linglong is willing to follow the Son of God!" Jun Linglong made up her mind and never wavered again.
From that sentence, Jun Linglong understood a lot.
Jun Xiaoyao nodded, this time the harvest was satisfactory.
By signing in, you can get the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power, break through the eternal realm, get heavenly rewards, and get the idea of ​​chaotic gods and demons.
He also received three immortal elixirs as a reward from the Eighteenth Ancestor.
In the end, he even recruited a blond girl as a maid, which can be said to be a complete success.
